name: floating-panel-slide-probe
description: Diagnostic. Captures the floating panel's slide-in and slide-out at 30fps so a person can check that the frost travels with the panel content instead of fading in place at the full panel rect, which read as a lighter ghost rectangle beside the sliding content.

actions.note: first paint, and the sidebar announces itself

actions.expression: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('.row'); if (!r) return 'no-row'; r.click(); return 'clicked'; })()
actions.note: the space's tab is cold at launch, so the row has to be pressed for the white page to paint in the MAIN window

actions.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.sbtoggle'); if (!b) return 'no-button'; b.click(); return 'clicked'; })()
actions.note: the row's own Hide button, not Cmd+S - the chord dies whenever an HTML surface holds first responder (a sibling scenario's note)

actions.pattern: Atrium: sidebar toggle requested from the chrome row
actions.note: a collapse that never ran leaves the pane docked, and a panel read over a docked pane says nothing
the white page with no panel over it - the control that says the region really is page, not chrome
park well inside the page first: the arming strip fires on the CROSSING, so two points already inside it fire nothing
started on the crossing, so the frames straddle the slide-in

actions.pattern: Atrium: sidebar overlay revealing at width

actions.note: off the panel, so the debounce runs out and the panel dismisses

assertions.pattern: Atrium: sidebar overlay revealing at width
assertions.label: the-panel-came-up
